result: The reported symptom (drafted lands counted at 0 in the post-draft Build Deck mana curve) no longer occurs on the v0.83.0 client. Commit ef0ada6a (2026-08-28, after the 2026-08-10 report) added `if (card === undefined || /\bland\b/i.test(card.type_line)) continue;` to the bucketing loop. Executing the shipped logic on a main deck of 10 cards (5 lands: basic, plain, snow + 5 spells incl. 0-cost Memnite) yields 0-bucket=1 (Memnite only), 5 cards counted, 5 lands excluded; the pre-fix revision yields 0-bucket=6.
